answer_4.quote: Then, we conduct a human evaluation regarding rule premises. 100 rules induced from D_a and another 100 rules from D_u are extracted at random for evaluation. We manually judge two criteria: 1) Whether the premise is consistent with the context in the origin sentence (Context). 2) Whether the premise should be mapped to the ground-truth label (Relation).
answer_4.guideline: Manually judge two criteria: consistency of the premise with the context in the original sentence and whether the premise maps to the ground-truth label.
